self_review: Challenged broad overlap candidates. Kept N only for active same-runtime exact overlaps: Rust SQLite, embeddings, MCP; Node Tauri renderer/host adapters. Classified cache, daemon, fs, HTTP, LLM, process, service, shell Rust, tauri Rust, updates, watch, transcript & product schemas NA where precise owner API or usable language bridge was absent. No M: no overlap has both local implementation & live shared production route.
